items.copy: Hi, I’m Iqbal, an independent KDP publisher creating Sudoku and puzzle books for enjoyable, screen-free activities. If you enjoy these puzzles, you can support my work by exploring my books, purchasing one, or leaving an honest review.

Sudoku with a Twist brings a colorful new challenge to classic Sudoku. With 84 unique puzzles and 42 different color-shape designs, each puzzle uses colored regions to add an extra rule: every color region must contain the numbers 1–9 exactly once. A fresh twist on a familiar favorite, with every puzzle offering a new shape and challenge.
